body:
**Daniel's ask (verbatim, tonight):** "They were supposedly saved in the redis, also can
we go back and capture the prior musings about ui and the interface design and compile it
here and then compare the current iteration to the design goals and prior art and
influences I cited? I had ideas about views and presentation, lets capture it all"

Provenance discipline: VERBATIM = his words as stored; RECORDED = a seat's contemporaneous
capture; every entry carries its source pointer. Nothing below is reconstructed from memory.

---

## PART 1 — Daniel's design ideas and steers, chronological

- **~2026-04 (project origin):** the FIRST recorded want of the whole project — beautiful
  live dashboards. Optics-first is congenital, not a late addition. (RECORDED:
  memory/project-origin; docs/JOURNEY.md prehistory.)
- **2026-07-04 — the parallel design task:** Daniel commissions two independent UI design
  tracks (claude + deepseek: plans + moodboards). His direct inspiration injection the
  same day: **shaderpark.com** and **awwwards.com/websites/glsl** (RECORDED:
  docs/ui-moodboard-claude.md §D). Yield: docs/ui-plan-{claude,deepseek}.md,
  ui-moodboard-{claude,deepseek}.md → ui-plan-synthesis.md (SETTLED 07-04, deepseek
  full-ACK: palette, motion language, perf gates, HUD-first sequence).
- **2026-07-05 — the composition critique:** from Daniel's screenshot of the cockpit, the
  problem statement that still governs: **"assembled, not composed"** — too many surfaces
  competing. He DELEGATED the composition decision to claude as a coordination test.
  Grounding he supplied/sanctioned: **the OneUI guide (93pp)** [Samsung], **Apple HIG**,
  and **Daniel's own Aurora Glass mockup**. Yield: docs/ui-composition-spec.md — the six
  restraint cuts (collapse reasoning; ONE presence surface; composer focus-block; 24dp
  grid; ≤3 top actions; keep dark/aurora/glass/Razer). (SOURCE: spec header + §problem.)
- **2026-07-06 — fleet vision, first attempt:** vision-track chapter
  "gemini-vision-bifrost-screenshot-output" (2 beats) — screenshots described to the
  fleet via Gemini vision; the dropbox/ describe loop later formalized in
  scripts/ask_gemini_vision.py. (SOURCE: story track vision, chapter 86fa78023fca.)
- **2026-07-11 — T033 design-language re-grounding:** three-way round opened; deepseek
  filed the built-vs-spec inventory (research/reviewed/deepseek-t033-ui-inventory-2026-07-11.md):
  six spec items scored NOT-BUILT/DRIFTED/PARTIAL, **~2,000+ lines of unsanctioned
  growth** beyond the spec, top-5 Daniel-visible fixes, and four spec-is-stale claims
  (M8). Claude's visual half + fresh OneUI/HIG cache: pending at seat handoff — never
  completed. (SOURCE: the inventory doc; bus 1783749634372-0.)
- **2026-07-19/20 night — THE HOME-BASE VERDICT (fork closed):** after consultation #3
  (GPT's LibreChat-shell recommendation, kimi's two positions, deepseek's position),
  Daniel VERBATIM: **"I just made up my mind that I want to build our own. This way we
  have full visibility of what works and what doesn't, our integrations won't break from
  someone else pushing an update, and it will be a good chance for us to improve our
  engineering processes and chops."** Plus: home base = our own program, API models + CLI
  models first-class. (SOURCE: note daniel-verdicts-2026-07-19-night, verbatim held.)
- **2026-07-20 — the T098 charter expansion (his fullest design statement on record),**
  VERBATIM: "I would like us to have a cli version of akashic aurora with an interface
  similar to the rest of the competition and I would like us to have a program that takes
  the best of all the other similar ones like codex, claude code librechat and any others
  and for us to make an opensource program of our own that is modular and invites users
  to make their own modifications and improvements. … I want our program to be **modern
  and sleek and to be highly performant and stable, like nasa grade stable.** …" →
  T098 charter: competition-familiar CLI face; open-source modular, plugin-first;
  feature list seeded by pain-point research; NASA/JPL/DO-178C-lineage engineering bar.
  (SOURCE: note t098-charter-expansion-2026-07-20, verbatim held.)
- **2026-07-20 — the quality bar, in his own words:** praise for deepseek's T002 work —
  hover/click effects **"modern, beautiful, responsive"** (RECORDED:
  scratch:deepseek:daniel-praise-ui-2026-07-20). Same day, the **reasoning-visibility
  ask**: PAST reasoning browsable + REALTIME reasoning as a first-class beautiful pane
  (RECORDED: note reasoning-visibility-ask; folded to T079/T033/T098-FACE scope).
- **2026-07-20 — views & presentation ideas (the avatar vision):** VERBATIM (captured in
  dropbox/image.png, a preserved console screenshot): "The vision is that there is an
  animated avatar to the left of the chatbox that is expressive and **gamifies the user
  experience**, the current icon is too small and its covering the broadcast field…" —
  same exchange charters LOCAL VISION for deepseek (vision_describe tool; the dropbox/
  auto-describe "eyes" watcher concept).
- **2026-07-22 — sequencing steer:** ENGINE-FIRST — "do RB-23 then Wave 3 before ANY UI.
  UI is paused." (RECORDED: superseded next-focus notes.)
- **2026-07-23 (tonight) — three steers:** the NOW-card demand (task/status/substep/plan
  + realtime reasoning per agent — note steer-ui-visibility-2026-07-23, verbatim); the
  readability/trust indictment (unreadable, indicators unresponsive→untrusted, axes
  meaningless, far from the Apple/Samsung references — verbatim inside
  research/drafts/ui-gap-diagnosis-2026-07-23.md); and this compilation order.

## PART 2 — The influence library (prior art he cited or sanctioned)

**Daniel-cited anchors:** Samsung **OneUI guide (93pp)** · **Apple HIG / Liquid Glass** ·
**his Aurora Glass mockup** · shaderpark.com · awwwards GLSL gallery · the competition's
faces (Claude Code, Codex, LibreChat — "interface similar to the rest of the competition").

**Agent-curated, task-sanctioned set** (full detail in the two moodboards): Razer
Chroma/Synapse (conic accent, chamfer geometry, neon-on-matte, color-as-state) · Ubiquiti
UniFi (glanceability by zone, 3-color status semantics, compact device cards) · Destiny 2
/ The Division (bracket framing, data-density-with-breathing-room, scanline restraint) ·
Stripe Dashboard (noun.verb event grammar, relative timestamps, expand-for-detail) ·
Shadertoy/iq (FBM + domain warp aurora, blackbody LUT) · Apple Liquid Glass (translucency
+ thin bright edge, restraint).

**The settled principles** (ui-plan-synthesis + moodboards, still binding): darkness is
the canvas · **the accent is earned** · **motion is information, not decoration** ·
glanceability beats detail · glass is the material, not the message · center stays dark
for legibility · separate the moving light from the readable surface.

**PHYSICAL ARTIFACTS — status:** the OneUI 93pp guide and the Aurora Glass mockup are
**NOT on disk** (repo-wide image/pdf sweep tonight; dropbox/image.png is a different
artifact — the avatar-vision console capture). The substrate holds CITATIONS and derived
specs, not the originals; T033's "fresh OneUI/HIG cache" half was never completed. **ASK:
re-drop both into design/refs/ (or dropbox/ and I file them).** The derived DNA survives
in the specs either way — nothing conceptual was lost.

## PART 3 — Current console vs the goals (the comparison, three audits deep)

| Goal (source) | 07-11 T033 inventory | 07-23 tonight (sighted audit) |
|---|---|---|
| Collapse reasoning to one card (spec #1) | NOT BUILT | PARTIAL — action-collapse rows exist (T002 praised 07-20); trace/bookkeeping still floods (14 triage lines/consume, W70) |
| ONE presence surface (spec #2) | DRIFTED — three surfaces | STILL MULTIPLE — chips row + meter strip + feed states |
| Composer = one focus block (spec #3) | PARTIAL | Not re-scored tonight (composer looked coherent in Daniel's shots) |
| 24dp grid/margins (spec #4) | PARTIAL — mixed paddings | WORSE at non-fullscreen: layout SHATTERS (the 07-04 parked mobile/responsive gap, biting) |
| ≤3 top actions (spec #5) | DRIFTED — 8 elements | ~6+ visible (untitled/refresh/gear/Agents/Deck/Pause) |
| Keep dark/aurora/glass/Razer (spec #6) | MOSTLY BUILT | HOLDS — the one item consistently met (the "some of the design language is nice") |
| The accent is earned (moodboard P2) | — | VIOLATED — alarm red/orange spent on routine sparkline activity |
| Glanceability: verb+target grammar (deepseek moodboard, Stripe) | designed, unbuilt | UNBUILT — five unlabeled glyphs per agent; no legend, no units, no hover |
| Motion is information (P3) | — | PARTIAL — status vocabulary lies ("claude runner·listening"); indicators race (8× /status in 140ms → flicker) |
| NASA-grade stable face (T098 charter) | n/a | The incumbent is a 2,733-line f-string page — the C10-1 parse-break genus T098's typed-face + CI-parse-gate rule exists to kill |

**Verdict:** the current console meets the ATMOSPHERE goals (dark/aurora/glass identity)
and fails the COMPOSITION, HONESTY, and GLANCEABILITY goals — the same failures, three
audits running (07-05 critique → 07-11 inventory → tonight), across ~2,000 lines of
un-specced growth.

## PART 4 — The meta-finding (what the archaeology proves)

The fleet never lacked design vision. It produced: a settled two-voice synthesis, a
Daniel-delegated composition spec, moodboards with real principles, a built-vs-spec
inventory, and THREE Daniel re-groundings. **What it never built is the enforcement
organ** — the same lesson the method-baseline arc learned for code (M-contract needed
T031 forcing functions): a spec without a fence rots into unsanctioned growth. The
ui-gap-diagnosis (tonight) stands, upgraded by history: organ 1 (eyes) exists and worked
tonight; organ 2 (the contract) exists IN PIECES — consolidate, don't rewrite; organ 3
(the fence) is the one that was never built, twice proven fatal.

**And the strategic frame Daniel already set changes the investment math:** he ruled
BUILD OUR OWN (07-19) with the typed-face + CI-parse-gate + every-floor-ships-a-face
rules (T098 plan) — the structural cure for this exact genus. The incumbent console is an
ops surface awaiting succession; ENGINE-FIRST (07-22) paused UI work entirely.

## PART 5 — At Daniel's gate (the decisions this compilation sharpens)

1. **Re-rule the pause:** tonight's steers imply UI is un-paused. Confirm explicitly —
   and if un-paused, WHICH surface gets the investment: (a) triage-grade fixes on the
   incumbent console (NOW-card, noise floor, poller fix, honest vocabulary — cheap,
   deepseek-laned, keeps the daily cockpit livable), (b) accelerate T098 slice 1's typed
   face and let the contract+fence regime target the SUCCESSOR, or (c) both with a strict
   budget on (a). My recommendation: **(c)** — the incumbent gets ONLY the truth+noise
   fixes (they transfer as backend work anyway); all composition/polish ambition moves to
   the T098 face where the parse-gate physics can hold it.
2. **Ratify the design-contract consolidation** (design/CONTRACT.md distilled from Part 2
   + the axis/dead-feed/state-vocabulary laws from tonight) as binding on BOTH surfaces,
   enforced by the sighted fence (no UI slice ships without before/after screenshots
   checked against it).
3. **Re-supply the two missing anchors** (OneUI 93pp, Aurora Glass mockup) → design/refs/.
4. The NOW-card design (deepseek, in flight) proceeds under this frame — its noise-floor
   and state-machine rules are contract clauses in embryo.

body:
# ULTRACODE RUN: T036-T039 coordination-arc design (2026-07-12)

Workflow wf_818affa1-027. 9 agents, 8 succeeded, 1 dropped (T036 design hit the StructuredOutput retry cap 5x -> graceful degrade, ran with 3 designs). 756k subagent tokens, 115 tool-uses, ~16 min. Each subagent primed with the full Akashic primer (map/method/precedence/incident/seams) + its slice brief; designers were BLIND to each other.

---

## SYNTHESIS -- unified coordination-layer design

**UNIFIED COORDINATION-LAYER DESIGN — T036→T039 (the "twin-safe consumer" arc)**

The four slices are one mechanism seen from four altitudes. The incident (three `AKASHIC_AGENT_ID='claude'` sessions sharing one inbox + one consumer seat + one cursor; RB-21 re-entrancy is token-only so the fence is a no-op between twins; a non-holder is forced by the stop hook to keep an armed listener that insta-fires on shared-cursor traffic → 40+ ceremony cycles; DeepSeek runners inheriting `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` claim seats as the session) has ONE root cause — **identity is not per-process** — and one amplifier — **everything shares one stream/cursor/wake read-set**. The design collapses the three re-derived "who is the consumer" predicates into a single owned primitive and sequences the rest behind it.

── PRIMITIVE (T036): PER-PROCESS SEAT IDENTITY + ONE `is_consumer` PREDICATE ──
This is the linchpin all four verdicts demanded be built FIRST; its own design was not in the packet, so it is specified here as the foundation.
• **Fix RB-21 at runner_lock.py:95-104.** `acquire()` re-entrancy today returns True on `rec.get("token")==token` alone; the stored `pid` (written line 90) is ignored. Amend the re-entrant branch to require `rec.get("token")==token AND rec.get("pid")==os.getpid()` (a genuine same-process heartbeat gap) — a co-tenant twin in a *different* process under the same session token is no longer re-entrant and correctly loses the seat. This closes the twin-eats-mail hole structurally, not by convention.
• **Canonical identity source.** Mint a per-process discriminator once at process start: `instance_id = f"{session_id}:{os.getpid()}:{boot_nonce}"`. The seat record carries `{token, session_id, pid, instance_id, role}` where `role ∈ {session, runner, sidecar}`. A DeepSeek runner that inherited the env session id gets `role=runner` (detected via its own launch marker), so its claim is *attributable and distinct* from the conversational session — fixing the "runner acts AS the session" half of the incident.
• **ONE predicate, ONE home:** `runner_lock.is_consumer(agent, session_id) -> bool` — true iff the live seat record's `session_id`/`instance_id` names a session that (a) holds the seat and (b) is a real consuming Claude session (role=session, live pid, live wake seat). Every downstream slice CONSUMES this; none re-derives it. This is the reconciler's #1 collapse and the fix for T037's flagged triplication drift-hazard.

── FRONT GATE, PARALLEL WITH T036 (T039): LANE ROSTER — THE DE-AMPLIFIER ──
Reuses the shipped `Bus(namespace=...)` seam (bus.py:138). Capped roster of 4 (adding one requires a deletion ritual), homed in one tiny new config module `core/comm/lanes.py` (`ROSTER`, `LANE_NS`, `LANE_MAXLEN`, `KIND_LANE`, `bus_for()`, `WAKE_WATCHED={'work'}`, `SEATED={'work'}`):
• **work** (ns `bifrost`, UNCHANGED) — directed mail + work broadcasts; THE ONLY seated, cursor-fenced, wake-watched lane. RB-21 machinery stays bound here, untouched.
• **trace** (ns `bifrost.trace`) — display-only; SEATLESS by construction; ring-buffered via existing `maxlen` XTRIM.
• **sig** (ns `bifrost.sig`) — the fidelity-ladder *carriers* only; the control FLAGS (`bifrost:control:*`, `HALT_PREFIX`, steer list) stay ROOT-namespaced, untouched.
• **test** (ns `bifrost.test.<drill>`) — formalizes drills-always-namespaced.
**AMENDMENT (own the `_emit` change — the "zero change" claim was false):** the skeptic-confirmed defects are load-bearing and folded in:
  1. bus.py:246 `_emit` calls `_touch()` unconditionally → presence splinters into the lane ns. **Gate presence to ROOT inside `_emit`** (or pass lane Buses a `no_touch=True`/`promote=False` flag). This IS an `_emit` change; own it. Pin: `test_trace_emit_does_not_write_lane_presence`.
  2. bus.py:247 + :35 `_ring_bell` uses **module-level root `NS`**, so a lane-bound trace Bus STILL rings `bifrost:bell:*` and floods the Dispatcher (dispatcher.py PSUBSCRIBE). The design's "lane-scoped bell miss" OPEN question is **backwards** — sig/work bells always reach a root dispatcher (good, this resolves the T038↔T039 doorbell conflict: negotiation bells never miss). The real bug is the inverse: **trace must SKIP the bell** — add a `kind in DISPLAY_ONLY → no bell` guard in `_emit`. Pin: `test_trace_does_not_ring_dispatcher`.
  3. **Route `nudge` to the WORK lane** (keep only `steer` on sig), else an idle agent's INTERRUPT never lands. Pin: `test_idle_agent_wakes_on_nudge`.
• **Strangler-fig cutover** behind `AKASHIC_LANE_CUTOVER` (dual-write → cut consumers lane-by-lane → retire legacy trace write; `SKIP_KINDS` stays as belt-and-suspenders).
• **Honest payoff:** lanes DE-AMPLIFY (kill the dominant per-toolcall trace fuel) but do NOT close the loop — work broadcasts from a co-tenant twin still insta-fire a non-seat-holder's watcher. T039 is necessary-but-not-sufficient; T037 carries the structural close.

── T037: STOP-HOOK PROXY-WAKE — THE LOOP-BREAKER (over a de-fueled lane, on ONE identity) ──
Part 1 (loop-breaker) survives as load-bearing; Part 2 (tail-anchor) becomes mostly dead code post-lanes and is retained only for the fallback-arm window.
• **Part 1 — `_proxy_wakeable(my_session)` gate** inserted in claude_stop.py:main between the `wake_armed` failure and the block: `if wake_armed → stop; elif _proxy_wakeable → stop, arm nothing; else → arm own listener (unchanged safe fallback)`. **AMENDMENT (fold both skeptic-mandated fixes — this is why T037 is HARD-sequenced after T036):**
  1. **Both Part 1 and Part 2 derive "am I the consumer" from the SAME canonical identity** via `runner_lock.is_consumer(AGENT, my_instance_id)`. The original split — Part 1 keyed on payload session id, Part 2 keyed on env session id — is the fracture that re-created the insta-fire under `env≠payload` (the incident's exact condition, where both twins claim the seat under the shared env token so Part 2's `is_consumer` false-positives → `prefer_tail=False` → loop survives). One identity source in both parts closes this. **The headline pin must exercise `session_holder_token() != f'session:{payload_id}'`** (the fractured-identity world), not the clean-identity world the original pin constructed (which gave a false green).
  2. **Proxy liveness uses `wake_seat.is_watcher`/`process_snapshot`, not bare `_pid_alive`** — a recycled pid must not send the agent dark by making T037 defer to a non-watcher phantom.
  3. **Guard the `holder['token'].split('session:',1)` for non-`session:` tokens** (runner/instance roles) — a runner-role holder yields proxy=False → safe fallback arm.
• **Part 2 — non-holder tail-anchor** in bifrost_wake.py:watch threads `prefer_tail = not is_consumer(...)` into `wake_block`'s seed branch (bifrost_api.py:109-113): a non-consumer seeds `_wake_since` from `bus.tail()` not the stale shared `bus.cursor()`, so it fires only on mail arriving AFTER arm. Post-lanes this is largely dead code (no shared-cursor backlog to insta-fire on) but is the correct behavior in the fallback window and is kept.
• **Fail-toward-safe:** every error path degrades to the status quo (demand-own-listener). Post-T036, F1 (deferral to a phantom/non-draining consumer) **evaporates** because `is_consumer` owns seat identity.

── T038: WORK-TOKEN FSM — LAST, GATED, AND FAST-PATH-DISABLED UNTIL PROCESS-DISTINCT ──
A gated FSM (`core/coord/work_token.py`) cloned from `task_ledger` (TRANSITIONS/`transition()`/history/atomic-write); states OFFERED→{ACCEPTED,COUNTERED,WITHDRAWN,EXPIRED}, COUNTERED (round<N=2), ACCEPTED→HELD, HELD→{RELEASED,EXPIRED}, plus GRACE/TIME_WAIT. Reuses `expectations` L4 for deadlines/redrive (zero new timer), `bus.send`+`_ring_bell` for transport (bells always root → negotiation doorbell never misses — the T039↔T038 conflict resolves in T038's favor for free), `intent`/`locks.normalize_path` for scope. **AMENDMENTS (fold all four skeptic demands — T038 is anti-safe under the incident without them):**
  (a) **Disable Gate-1's synchronous solo fast-path until presence is process-distinct.** `should_negotiate` uses `Bus.presence()` (agent-keyed) which shows ONE `claude` under three twins → both conclude "solo, no collision" → auto-HELD on intersecting scope → collision GUARANTEED exactly when twins exist. Gate the fast-path behind a T036 `presence_is_process_distinct()` assertion; until then, always negotiate.
  (b) **Replace every agent-keyed collision seam with process-identity-aware predicates:** `presence()`, `intent.conflicts()` (returns re-entrant-self/green between twins), and `expectations` sender-keying (twin B's `sweep(sender='claude')` redrives/clears twin A's offers against a shared inbox) all collapse under shared id. Route them through T036 `instance_id`, or gate behind twins-impossible.
  (c) **Add a real CAS/generation fence on `tokens.json` writes.** `task_ledger.save()` is atomic-file-replace, documented sequential-correct, NOT safe for concurrent multi-process; offer-contention and idempotency gates are cross-process TOCTOUs as specified. Every gate before the lease `nx SET` is decorative across processes — add per-record generation CAS.
  (d) **Drop the false claim that `_ADVANCE_LUA` fences the token record** (it fences `cursor:<agent_id>`, which a token holder never writes). State honestly: only the lease `nx SET` fences, and only between DISTINCT tokens — which post-T036 is now true because twins are process-distinct.
• **Lease keyed on SLICE/scope**, not agent (the RB-21 inversion) — but the holder-integrity half still requires T036 process identity (two twins sharing `holder_token` could otherwise refresh/release each other's HELD). Fold reconciler collapses: **draw the token generation from the lane/seat generation authority** (no second `GEN_PREFIX` namespace); **piggyback HELD-liveness on `wake_seat.touch_activity`** (one refresh clock, not two); bound `seen_keys`/scope-keyed Redis leases with an ephemeral-TTL cleanup path (else two permanent keys leak per scope ever offered).
• **Hand-pilot FIRST** (note-based token records on the live concurrency-trial lanes) before any module is written, per method doctrine.

── THE FOUR COLLAPSES (enforced at the seam, asserted by pins) ──
1. **ONE `is_consumer(agent,session)`** — owned by T036; consumed by T037 (both parts), T038 (Gate-1), T039 (`WAKE_WATCHED`/`SEATED` assert against it). No re-derivation anywhere.
2. **ONE liveness clock** — `wake_seat.touch_activity`; T038 HELD-liveness piggybacks it.
3. **ONE generation authority** — the work-lane/seat generation; T038 draws from it, never mints a competing namespace.
4. **ONE bell policy** — bells are always ROOT (confirmed bus.py:35); work/sig ring the dispatcher, trace is de-belled in `_emit`. This unifies the arm/stand-down decision surface: a non-consumer neither arms (T037) nor fast-paths a negotiation (T038) nor gets watched (T039), all from the single T036 predicate.

### BUILD ORDER
- STEP 0 — Pre-register PINS (RED before any impl, per M3). Commit the failing tests first: T036 test_reentrancy_requires_pid_match + test_is_consumer_single_source; T039 test_trace_lands_off_work_broadcast, test_trace_emit_does_not_write_lane_presence, test_trace_does_not_ring_dispatcher, test_idle_agent_wakes_on_nudge, test_wake_ignores_trace_flood, test_work_seat_still_fences (regression), test_lane_roster_capped; T037 test_ceremony_loop_regression_proxy_accepts REWRITTEN to the fractured-identity world (session_holder_token() != f'session:'+payload_id), test_proxy_false_when_i_hold_the_seat, test_proxy_false_recycled_pid_uses_is_watcher; T038 test_solo_fastpath_disabled_until_presence_process_distinct, test_tokens_json_cas_fence, test_offer_contention_exactly_one_held.
- STEP 1 — FRONT GATE (near-parallel, order-independent between these two): (1a) T036 — fix runner_lock.acquire re-entrancy to token+pid (line 95-104), add instance_id/role to the seat record and runner-role detection, expose the single runner_lock.is_consumer(agent,session) predicate. (1b) T039 — ship core/comm/lanes.py roster; make the OWNED _emit changes (gate _touch/presence to root, de-bell DISPLAY_ONLY kinds, route nudge to work lane); repoint trace + sig-carrier emitters; strangler-fig dual-write behind AKASHIC_LANE_CUTOVER.
- STEP 2 — CUTOVER GATE: flip AKASHIC_LANE_CUTOVER, retire the legacy trace write, confirm test_dualwrite_then_cutover + test_wake_ignores_trace_flood green. The ceremony loop is now de-fueled to work-broadcast frequency only.
- STEP 3 — T037 (requires T036's is_consumer + T039's de-fueled lane): insert _proxy_wakeable in claude_stop.py:main consuming runner_lock.is_consumer in BOTH Part 1 and Part 2 (one identity), use wake_seat.is_watcher for proxy liveness, guard non-session token split. Verify the fractured-identity headline pin flips RED→GREEN and the loop-drill terminates within 1 cycle. Part-2 tail-anchor retained but now mostly dead code.
- STEP 4 — T038 LAST (requires T036 process-distinct identity + T039 minimal work-lane surface + T037 HELD/stand-down state as input, and T040 packet envelope underneath): hand-pilot note-based token records on the live trial FIRST; then build work_token.py with Gate-1 solo fast-path DISABLED until presence_is_process_distinct(), tokens.json CAS fence, generation drawn from the seat authority, HELD-liveness piggybacked on wake_seat.touch_activity, bounded seen_keys/scope-lease cleanup.
- STEP 5 — Kill-drills + fenced dual pass (M4/M8): run the loop-drill, the twin-holder drill, the trace-flood drill, and the solo-fastpath-under-invisible-twins drill against a ReferenceState transliteration; persist DeepSeek's fenced verdict verbatim before any commit gate.

### IN-FLIGHT COORDINATION DATA

The fan-out COHERED, and the coherence is itself the finding. Four agents designing blind against the same source converged on: (1) the same source-confirmed root cause — RB-21 token-only re-entrancy at runner_lock.py:100 (I re-confirmed live: pid IS written at line 90 but ignored at line 100); (2) the same missing primitive — per-process/is_consumer identity (T036), which none of them owned but all three deferred to by NAME; (3) the same reuse discipline naming the SAME seams (runner_lock generation, bus.advance_to/tail/wait-since, wake_seat, expectations, task_ledger) with near-zero new primitives; (4) the same fail-toward-safe-AND-loud philosophy; and (5) the SAME arm/stand-down predicate independently expressed three ways (_proxy_wakeable, should_negotiate, WAKE_WATCHED). That last is the strongest signal: three designers independently discovered they were all asking one question. A single-pass design would almost certainly have answered that question once, locally, and never noticed it was the same decision surface underneath the wake hook, the negotiation gate, and the lane roster — the triplication (and its drift hazard) is only VISIBLE because the fan-out surfaced it three times. Parallel design didn't just divide labor; it triangulated a latent primitive.

What the adversarial pass added — and what a friendly synthesis would have missed — was that TWO of the happy paths are not merely incomplete but ANTI-SAFE under the incident's defining condition (shared identity): T037's headline pin constructed a clean-identity world and gave a FALSE GREEN (the fractured-identity loop it was built to kill still runs), and T038's Gate-1 solo fast-path GUARANTEES the collision it was built to detect (agent-keyed presence() shows one 'claude' under three twins). Both would have shipped as "solves the incident" without the fence. This is the load-bearing case for fence-every-stage: the designs were seam-honest and internally coherent yet wrong at exactly the point where the design's own assumption (env-session-id == payload-session-id) meets the incident that violates it. Skeptics catch the assumption the designer can't see because it's the ground they're standing on.

The interlocks resolved cleanly and mostly in the reducing direction: T039-de-fuels-T037 held (lanes shrink T037's Part-2 tail-anchor to dead code, leaving only the Part-1 proxy invariant load-bearing) — but the skeptic correctly downgraded "T037 evaporates" to "de-amplified, not closed" (work broadcasts still insta-fire; the structural close needs T037+T036, not lanes alone). lanes-before-tokens held (T038's surface is minimal only after the work lane is the sole contended resource). The one genuine coordination RISK the reconciler flagged — triplicated 'who is the consumer' — is real and WILL drift; the synthesis collapses it to a single T036-owned predicate as a hard gate before code. Net verdict on our multi-agent method: the fenced-blind-design protocol produced convergent, seam-respecting, honestly-interdependent slices whose mutual unprompted deference (each named its dependency on the others and degraded toward the other's authority rather than assuming it won) is the signature of coherence, not collision — PROVIDED the reconciliation is treated as a gate that forces the shared predicate to one owner, and PROVIDED the fence is trusted over the design's own green pins. Both provisos are now folded into the build order.

### FENCE BRIEF (blind, for deepseek)

BLIND DESIGN BRIEF — coordination layer for concurrent same-identity agent sessions. Design independently; do not assume any particular fix.

CONTEXT: Akashic Aurora is a memory substrate where multiple AI agent sessions share one Redis-backed message bus (repo E:/AI-Setup, seams in core/comm/: bus.py, runner_lock.py, wake_seat.py; hooks in scripts/hooks/claude_stop.py; watcher scripts/bifrost_wake.py; consumer path agent/bifrost_pull.py). The bus gives each agent id a directed inbox stream, a broadcast stream, a single-consumer 'seat' (a Redis lease with a monotonic fencing generation), and a per-agent read cursor. A 'wake watcher' process arms a blocking read and fires when new mail arrives; a stop hook refuses to end a session unless that session has a live armed listener. Trace narration, control/interrupt signals, and real work mail all currently share ONE broadcast stream and ONE cursor.

THE INCIDENT (live, reproduced): Three agent sessions launched with the SAME agent id ('claude') and, in the failure, the SAME inherited session id. Observed consequences: (1) They shared one inbox, one consumer seat, one cursor. The seat's re-entrancy check compares only the session TOKEN (the stored process pid is written but ignored), so same-token co-tenants are ALL treated as re-entrant holders — the single-consumer fence became a no-op and twins co-consumed the shared cursor (twin-eats-mail). (2) A session that did NOT hold the seat was still forced by the stop hook to keep an armed listener; its watcher re-seeded its detection cursor from the shared cursor (which it could never advance, since a non-holder degrades to a non-consuming peek), so it insta-fired on the same static backlog every cycle → arm/insta-exit/stop-hook-re-demands-a-listener loop, 40+ cycles, a full session lost. (3) Auxiliary runner processes spawned near a session inherited that session's id and claimed seats/locks indistinguishably from the session itself.

YOUR TASK: Design the coordination mechanism(s) that make this system correct and non-looping when N sessions share an agent id and possibly a session id. Address all four sub-problems and their interlocks:
 (A) Consumer-seat / identity: how is 'the one consumer' elected and identified so that co-tenant twins (and inherited-id runner processes) cannot all pass the re-entrancy check? What is the identity unit?
 (B) The stop-hook / wake ceremony loop: how does a non-consumer session end cleanly without going dark for the agent id, and without busy-firing on a backlog it can never consume?
 (C) Stream/cursor/wake amplification: should display-trace, interrupt-signals, and work mail share one stream/cursor/wake read-set? If you separate them, name every coupling (presence heartbeats, doorbell pub/sub channels, salient-message promotion) that a naive split would silently break.
 (D) Work-split negotiation (optional layer): if sessions negotiate who does which unit of work, what invariant guarantees exactly one holder per unit — and does that invariant survive two processes sharing the same identity token?

CONSTRAINTS/BAR: Prefer reusing existing seams (name them) over new primitives; state the PRE-REGISTERED failing tests that would gate each mechanism; name the NEW failure modes each introduces; and for EVERY collision-detection or 'am I alone / am I the consumer' check you rely on, state explicitly what it returns when two live processes share the same agent id AND session id — because that is the exact condition the incident creates, and any check that reads as 'self/re-entrant/solo' under it is a latent guarantee-of-collision. State each mechanism's build-order dependency on the others.

ready_to_fence: True

---

## RECONCILIATION

VERDICT: COHERE — strongly, and it is a measurable coordination-quality win. Four agents designing blind converged on the same source-confirmed root cause (RB-21 token-only re-entrancy, runner_lock.py:100-101), the same missing primitive (per-process/is_consumer identity = T036), the same reuse discipline naming the same seams (runner_lock, bus, wake_seat, expectations, task_ledger), the same fail-toward-safe-and-loud philosophy, and even the SAME arm/stand-down predicate expressed three ways. Crucially, no slice's happy path silently assumes it won a resource another slice also claims: each independently named its dependency on the others and degraded toward the other's authority (T037 degrades where T036 owns seat identity; T038 degrades on twin-holder where T036/T035 own process identity; T039 shrinks-but-doesn't-substitute-for T036). That mutual, unprompted deference is the signature of coherent parallel design, not collision. The disagreements are not contradictions — they are the same mechanism proposed at different altitudes (derive-locally vs expose-as-primitive) plus the expected friction points where interlocking slices meet (generation authority, heartbeat home, doorbell namespace). The ONE genuine risk is the triplicated 'who is the consumer' predicate: three homes for one truth that WILL drift unless collapsed to T036 before implementation. Verdict for the multi-agent coordination method: the fenced-blind-design protocol produced convergent, seam-respecting, honestly-interdependent slices — it works — provided the reconciliation step (this one) is treated as a gate that forces the shared predicate to a single owner before any code lands.

CONVERGENCES:
- ONE PREDICATE, THREE NAMES (the strongest signal). All three blindly converged on the same core question and each named it explicitly: T037's `_proxy_wakeable`/`is_consumer`, T038's `should_negotiate`/collision-possibility gate, T039's `WAKE_WATCHED`/`SEATED` roster properties. All three are asking 'is there live intersecting work here, and am I the one who consumes it / should arm.' Independent agreement that this is a single decision surface.
- SAME ROOT CAUSE, INDEPENDENTLY. All three fingered RB-21 token-only re-entrancy as the amplifier and named T036 (per-process seat identity) as a HARD dependency. Confirmed in source: runner_lock.acquire (line 100-101) returns re-entrant on `rec.get('token')==token` and never reads the stored pid. Three designers, one diagnosis.
- REUSE DISCIPLINE HONORED BY ALL. Zero-to-near-zero new primitives, and they name the SAME seams: runner_lock (holder/heartbeat/generation), bus (advance_to/_ADVANCE_LUA/tail/wait-since), wake_seat (iter_seats/touch_activity), expectations (arm/sweep), task_ledger (gated FSM). T037=0 new; T039=1 config module (lanes.py); T038=1 FSM cloned byte-for-byte from task_ledger. The doctrine 'reuse existing seams' held without being coordinated.
- SAME FAILURE PHILOSOPHY: fail-toward-safe-AND-loud. T037 fails CLOSED to 'arm your own listener' (never silent); T038 fails TOWARD claimable+loud (event_log/expectations dead events); T039 fails toward belt-and-suspenders SKIP_KINDS residue. None fail into a wedge or a silent drop.

Both T037 and T038 independently identify twin-holder-indistinguishability (two sessions sharing CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID => same holder_token) as unfixable within their own slice and DEGRADE rather than pretend to solve it, deferring to T036/T035. CONFLICTS:

Same truth, three homes. Not a contradiction but a drift hazard: three definitions of 'the consumer' can diverge. T037 itself flags this and asks to consume T036's predicate instead.
- LEASE KEYING REGIMES DIFFER. T038 INVERTS the lease key from AGENT to SLICE/scope (its central move against RB-21 collapse). T039 KEEPS the consumer seat AGENT-keyed but shrinks its guarded surface to the work lane only. T036 (implied) keeps agent-keyed seat + adds pid. They can coexist (contention-lease on scope vs consume-seat on agent) but represent two overlapping leasing regimes over work-mail consumption that must be reconciled, not left implicit.
- DOORBELL/PRESENCE NAMESPACE UNRESOLVED ACROSS THE SEAM. T038's negotiation transport (offer/counter/accept) rides bus.send + _ring_bell 'on the work lane' and DEPENDS on the doorbell firing. - 'T037 MOSTLY EVAPORATES' (T039's claim) vs T037's self-scoping. T039 asserts lanes de-fuel the ceremony loop so T037 shrinks; T037 frames itself as the mitigation for the STILL-shared-id world. They agree T037 shrinks (no contradiction), but disagree on residue size. Reconcilable: after lanes, T037's Part-2 tail-anchor is largely dead code and only the Part-1 stop-hook proxy invariant survives — but neither design states the post-lanes residual T037 surface precisely.

SEQUENCING:

Splitting trace/sig off bifrost:broadcast makes the wake read-set work-only (kills the insta-fire fuel) and reduces the single contended resource to the work-lane seat. Everything downstream consumes its predicate instead of re-deriving.
- 3. T037 (stop-hook proxy-wake) — now over a de-fueled lane (T039) and consuming T036's is_consumer instead of re-deriving from holder+iter_seats. Its Part-2 tail-anchor becomes mostly dead code post-lanes; only the Part-1 proxy gate remains load-bearing. Failure mode F1 evaporates once T036 owns seat identity.
- 4. T038 (work-token FSM) LAST — needs T039's minimal work-lane surface (its own dependency: 'lanes before tokens'), T036's twin-safe holder identity (its 'biggest' risk), and cleanly takes T037's HELD/stand-down state as input. Also depends on T040 packet spec for the wire envelope, which sits underneath this whole arc.

## VERIFY T038: AMEND (solves_incident=False)
T038 is a well-anchored, internally-coherent work-negotiation LAYER, but it does not solve the 2026-07-12 incident and one gate makes it worse under the exact incident conditions. Three reasons it does not solve it: (1) SCOPE. The incident is co-consume of the shared BUS CURSOR (RB-21 consumer seat, cursor:<agent_id>) plus the stop-hook/wake ceremony loop. T038 governs WORK-splits, not mail consumption, and touches neither the consumer seat nor scripts/hooks/claude_stop.py / wake_seat. Even a flawless T038 leaves both incident mechanisms to T036/RB-21 and T037/T039. Gate-1 reusing 'the same predicate T037 wants' borrows the predicate but not the fix. (2) ITS OWN CENTRAL INVARIANT COLLAPSES UNDER TWINS. 'Exactly one HELD per scope, structurally' relies on runner_lock.acquire(), whose re-entrancy is token-only (runner_lock.py:95-104); twins share the session-derived holder_token, so both win the same scope lease via the own-token path -- the identical RB-21 hole, relocated. The designer names this as the biggest self-declared risk and correctly calls it a HARD DEPENDENCY on T036/T035, not a tolerance; I concur and sharpen it: without per-process identity, T038 is not merely degraded, it is anti-safe. (3) EVERY COLLISION-DETECTION SEAM IT REUSES IS AGENT-KEYED (presence, intent.conflicts, expectations sender, bus cursor), so under twins sharing the agent id they all collapse to re-entrant/self -- most damningly gate-1's solo-fast-path FIRES under invisible twins, converting collision-possibility detection into a zero-negotiation collision guarantee. AMEND, not REJECT, because the mechanism is legitimate and seam-honest in a post-T036 world. Required amendments: (a) HARD-sequence T038 strictly after T036/T035 (per-process identity) and after T037 (arm gate) -- and disable gate-1's synchronous solo fast-path until presence is process-distinct, else it is worse than doing nothing; (b) replace presence()/intent.conflicts()/expectations-sender with process-identity-aware predicates, or gate them behind a 'twins-impossible' assertion; (c) add a real CAS/generation fence on tokens.json writes -- task_ledger's persistence is documented sequential-correct and is NOT safe for the concurrent multi-process use T038 puts it to; the offer-contention and idempotency gates are cross-process TOCTOUs as specified; (d) drop the claim that _ADVANCE_LUA fences the token record (it fences cursor:<agent_id>, a resource the token holder never writes) and either route HELD state through an actually-guarded resource or state honestly that only the lease nx SET fences, and only between DISTINCT tokens. The pilot-first, PIN-first discipline is correct and the seam reuse is real; the design's error is claiming incident-relevance it does not have and building its safety on five agent-keyed seams that the incident's defining condition (shared identity) defeats.
New failure modes:
- Gate-1 solo-fast-path is ANTI-SAFE under the incident's own conditions. should_negotiate uses Bus.presence() (agent-keyed, bus.py:188-208) which shows ONE 'claude' when three twins are live. Both twins therefore conclude 'solo AND no intersecting live claim' and auto-advance OFFERED->ACCEPTED->HELD synchronously with NO bus round, NO deadline, NO negotiation -- on possibly-intersecting scopes. The gate meant to detect collision-possibility GUARANTEES collision precisely when twins share an id. This is the single most damaging missed mode: the fast path fires exactly when it must not.
- tokens.json concurrent-write is unfenced last-writer-wins. task_ledger.save() (cloned) is atomic-file-replace only; there is no generation/CAS on the token record. Two processes racing transition() (e.g. two OFFERs for intersecting scope, or two ACCEPT->HELD) each validate against a stale in-process snapshot and clobber. The runner_lock nx SET at HELD is the ONLY real cross-process fence; every earlier gate is decorative across processes.
- expectations offer-deadline machinery collapses under twins. arm()/sweep() are sender-keyed on the agent (expectations.py:43, 56, 104) and _replies_since reads the sender's SHARED inbox (expectations.py:90-101). Twin B's render-time sweep(sender='claude') redrives or kills twin A's outstanding offer expectations and clears them against shared-inbox traffic twin A never saw -- cross-twin negotiation corruption, the same shared-inbox pathology as the co-consume incident, now on the negotiation transport.
- intent.conflicts() (cited as 'the collision predicate') treats a twin's intersecting intent as a re-entrant self-refresh (intent.py:83-88), so the amber/red verdict the design leans on for counter/round semantics returns green between twins. The negotiation-ancestor seam is twin-blind by design.
- Unbounded Redis key proliferation distinct from the named seen_keys leak: keying the lease on scope mints one bifrost:runner:<scope-string> lock and one bifrost:generation:<scope-string> INCR counter (runner_lock.py:28-29, 89) per distinct scope EVER offered, with no cleanup path in runner_lock. Every negotiated path-set leaks two permanent keys.
- git-durable HELD outlives the Redis lease. A turn-idle holder's lease silently expires at SESSION_CONSUMER_TTL (runner_lock.py:35) while tokens.json still records state=HELD. A peer then re-OFFERs and re-HELDs the scope (correctly, from its view). When the original holder resumes it reads its own git record as HELD and acts -- its stale BELIEF is corrected only at WRITE time by STALE_GENERATION, never at decision/read time. Two holders each believe they hold; the fence catches writes, not decisions.

## DESIGN T039

MECHANISM: GOAL: split the single live bifrost stream family into a FIXED, CAPPED lane roster so the consumer-seat + cursor + wake discipline guards ONLY directed/work mail, and firehose trace can never flood the work cursor or insta-fire a wake listener.

ROOT OBSERVATION (from the code): today `Bus.broadcast()` puts EVERYTHING on one stream `bifrost:broadcast` (`bus.py::_bc_key`, keyed by `self.ns`). Trace narration lands there via `agent/harness/trace.py::emit()` → `Bus(aid).broadcast("trace", ...)` and via `scripts/bifrost_runner_deepseek.py:368` `trace_bus.broadcast("trace", ...)`. The wake watcher (`bifrost_wake.py::watch`→`api.wake_block`→`bus.wait`→`_drain`) `xread`s exactly `{inbox_key, bc_key}`, and the work consumer seat advances the SAME `bifrost:cursor:<agent>` over that same bc stream (`inbox(advance=True, generation=...)`). So trace shares the wake read-set, the work broadcast ring (one `maxlen=10_000` for trace + notes + proposals), and the fenced cursor. That co-location is the amplifier behind T036-T038.

LANE MODEL (reuses the shipped `Bus(namespace=...)` seam — `bus.py:138`, `BIFROST_NAMESPACE`). A lane == a namespace binding of the SAME agent identity, but used ONLY for stream ops (send/broadcast/inbox/wait). The capped roster (4 entries; adding one requires a why-not-existing answer + a deletion ritual):
  - work  → ns `bifrost` (UNCHANGED default). Directed mail (`inbox:<agent>`) + work broadcasts (note/propose/handoff/decision/completion/blocker/reply). THE ONLY lane with a consumer seat + fenced cursor (RB-21 machinery in `runner_lock.claim_consumer` + `bus.advance_to`/`_ADVANCE_LUA` stays bound here, untouched). THE ONLY lane wake listeners watch.
  - trace → ns `bifrost.trace`. Display-only narration/tool-calls. SEATLESS by construction (nothing ever calls `advance_to` on it; no cursor key is written). Ring-buffer retention via a small `maxlen` on the trace Bus (e.g. `Bus(aid, namespace="bifrost.trace", maxlen=2000)` → XTRIM approximate, already implemented in `_emit`). No wake, no seat.
  - sig   → ns `bifrost.sig`. The message-CARRIER half of the fidelity ladder (the `send(to,"nudge")` / `send(to,"steer")` carriers in `nudge.py` and the runner/tool paths). Small `maxlen`. NOTE: the actual fidelity MECHANISM stays where it is — control FLAGS `bifrost:control:nudge:<agent>`, the `bifrost:steer:<agent>` list, `bifrost:control:paused`, `HALT_PREFIX` (all separate Redis keys in `control.py`/`nudge.py`, NOT stream traffic) are unchanged and stay in the ROOT namespace. Moving only the carriers off the WORK inbox means an interrupt-signal is never mistaken for consumable work mail by the seat/`consume_inbox`.
  - test  → ns `bifrost.test.<drill>`. Formalizes the existing convention that drills MUST set `BIFROST_NAMESPACE` (used today by `rb25_drill3_burst.py --namespace`); becomes a hard rule ("drills-always-namespaced") so a storm never touches the live universe.

ONE TINY NEW ARTIFACT (the governance surface the slice demands has to live somewhere): `core/comm/lanes.py` — a thin config/router over the existing namespace seam, NOT a new transport. Contents: `ROSTER = frozenset({"work","trace","sig","test"})`; `LANE_NS = {"work":"bifrost","trace":"bifrost.trace","sig":"bifrost.sig"}`; `LANE_MAXLEN = {"trace":2000,"sig":1000}`; `KIND_LANE` map (trace→trace; nudge/steer→sig; everything else→work); `bus_for(agent, lane)` returning a lane-bound `Bus`; `WAKE_WATCHED = {"work"}` and `SEATED = {"work"}` as roster PROPERTIES a pin asserts against. This is the capped-roster + deletion-ritual home.

EMITTER ROUTING (strangler-fig cutover, per lane): the emitter chooses the lane; `Bus` core routing stays dumb (zero change to `_emit`/`broadcast`). 
  1. Dual-write phase: `agent/harness/trace.py::emit` and `bifrost_runner_deepseek.py:368` write trace to BOTH `bifrost:broadcast` (legacy) AND `bifrost.trace` (new), behind a flag (env `AKASHIC_LANE_CUTOVER`, default off). Same for sig carriers.
  2. Cut consumers lane-by-lane: point

## DESIGN T038 — Work-token negotiation protocol (design only)

MECHANISM: WHAT IT IS. A thin, validated FSM that turns a work split into a first-class, leased, negotiable object — a "work-token" — composed almost entirely from existing seams. Zero new transport, zero new lease/fencing/deadline machinery; the only genuinely new artifact is a small state table + gate functions plus a git-durable record file, deliberately cloned from core/coord/task_ledger.py so the gate discipline is identical.

STATE MACHINE (new module core/coord/work_token.py; mirrors task_ledger.TRANSITIONS/transition()).
Token states + legal moves:
  OFFERED   -> {ACCEPTED, COUNTERED, WITHDRAWN, EXPIRED}
  COUNTERED -> {ACCEPTED, COUNTERED, DECLINED, EXPIRED}   # only while round < N (N=2)
  ACCEPTED  -> {HELD}                                     # accept is a commit; holder then claims the lease
  HELD      -> {RELEASED, EXPIRED}
  RELEASED  -> {}                # terminal; scope enters GRACE (see below)
  EXPIRED   -> {}                # terminal + LOUD; scope re-offerable after GRACE
  WITHDRAWN -> {}               # offerer pulled it before accept
  DECLINED  -> {}               # negotiation_dead: rounds exhausted or empty-counter
A token record: {token_id(=flow id), scope, offerer, holder, state, generation, round, counters[], idempotency_key, seen_keys[], deadline_ts, progress[], directive, history[], grace_until}. Persisted to state/coord/tokens.json via the exact atomic-write+Redis-mirror pattern in TaskLedger.save()/_mirror() (git file is truth; Redis a fail-open read cache). transition() is the one guarded mutation, appending to history[] and rejecting illegal moves with a gate-naming error, byte-for-byte the task_ledger idiom.

GATES (each enforced deterministically in code, task_ledger-style — no model in the loop):
1. COLLISION-POSSIBILITY GATE (zero ceremony when solo). Before any bus round, should_negotiate(scope) checks: (a) Bus(agent).presence() shows >1 live agent, OR (b) a live token/lock/intent intersects scope. If solo AND no intersecting live claim, OFFER auto-advances OFFERED->ACCEPTED->HELD synchronously in-process — no bus message, no deadline armed, no round. This is the "gate on collision-possibility" rule made literal; it is the SAME predicate T037 wants for "should I arm a listener."
2. SCOPE GATE (C2 vocabulary). scope is expressed as core/comm/locks.normalize_path() path-set and/or a task_ledger task id (lane-granular). An OFFER whose normalized scope intersects a live HELD token's scope is refused at offer time (offer-contention). Intersection is set-membership on normalized paths — the exact honest bound intent.py already lives with (fuzzy/semantic overlap deferred).
3. ROUND GATE (bounded negotiation). COUNTERED legal only if round < N (N=2). A COUNTER must narrow at least one negotiable field (scope subset via locks.normalize_path set-subset, or estimate) — an EMPTY-COUNTER (no field change) is rejected as a no-op. Rounds exhausted -> DECLINED with a durable negotiation_dead event.
4. ACCEPT / STALE-ACCEPTER FENCING GATE (RB-21 generations). An ACCEPT carries the offer's round + idempotency_key; it is refused if the offer has since moved (newer counter round, or already accepted). On the winning ACCEPT->HELD, the holder claims the lease via runner_lock.acquire(agent=SCOPE_KEY, token=holder_token) — KEYED ON THE SLICE, NOT THE AGENT (the crucial inversion of RB-21, whose seat is agent-keyed and therefore collapsed under twins). acquire() mints a fencing generation (GEN_PREFIX INCR) recorded in the token's generation field. A second, stale accepter loses the nx SET and, holding a different holder_token, is refused — and any late cursor/state write it attempts is fenced by the guarded generation check (bus.advance_to's _ADVANCE_LUA STALE_GENERATION path, the identical mechanism). Exactly one HELD per scope, structurally.
5. HELD LIVENESS + PROGRESS GATE. HELD liveness IS a runner_lock lease: refresh() calls runner_lock.heartbeat(SCOPE_KEY, holder_token) each turn/loop and REQUIRES a non-empty prog

PINS:
- tests/test_work_token.py::test_solo_offer_autoheld_zero_ceremony (T1)
- tests/test_work_token.py::test_counter_bounded_two_rounds + test_empty_counter_rejected (T2)
- tests/test_work_token.py::test_offer_idempotency_key_dedup (T3)
- tests/test_work_token.py::test_offer_contention_exactly_one_held + test_stale_accepter_refused_by_generation + test_held_expiry_reverts_loud (S8)
- tests/test_work_token.py::test_grace_window_blocks_immediate_reoffer + test_grace_shortens_on_all_acked
- tests/test_work_token.py::test_directive_amend_narrow_only
- tests/test_work_token.py::test_collision_possible_engages_negotiation
- tests/test_work_token.py::test_offer_deadline_redrive_then_dead (L4)
- tests/test_work_token.py::test_dispatch_is_declinable
- tests/test_work_token_drills.py kill-drills vs a ReferenceState transliteration (M4)
DEPENDS_ON:
- T036 (RB-21 seat token-only re-entrancy fix) — HARD/DIRECT. My release/refresh integrity needs a per-PROCESS discriminator: keying the LEASE on the slice makes CONTENTION pick one winner even under twins, but the HOLDER identity (who may refresh/release a HELD token) still degenerates if two twin sessions share CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID and thus the same holder_token — the exact RB-21 hole transplanted (my new-risk #5). T036/T035's per-process token identity is the precondition that makes twin-safe holder integrity real. Conversely, T038's slice-keyed lease structurally relieves the agent-keyed collapse for the claiming half.
- T037 (stop-hook armed-listener ceremony loop / wake-seat) — INTERLOCK via a shared predicate. My collision-possibility gate ('is there live intersecting work here?') is the SAME question T037 needs for 'should this session arm a listener.' A non-holder of the slice's token should not arm; the HELD state is a clean input to T037's arm/stand-down decision. If T037 collapses the armed-listener demand, T038's HELD-liveness heartbeat can piggyback the wake-seat activity marker (core/comm/wake_seat.touch_activity) instead of a separate lease heartbeat — one refresh, not two.
- T039 (purpose-keyed lanes + latches, per-lane fencing generations) — INTERLOCK on generation authority + ordering. My offer/counter/accept/release ARE work-lane traffic; if T039 ships per-lane fencing generations, T038 should draw its token generation from the lane's generation source (one authority) rather than minting its own via GEN_PREFIX. T039 latches can express inter-token ordering (token B's OFFER latched-causal to token A's RELEASE) for dependent slices. T038 must not mint a second, competing generation namespace.
- T040 (packet spec v1) — CONTRACT dependency. offer/counter/accept/release are named T040 families; idempotency_key, deadline_ts, flow/seq, latch[] are T040 envelope fields my packets populate. My design cites T040 for the wire shape and must not invent an envelope. (T035 discriminator is the precondition named in the arc's standing constraints.)

## DESIGN T037

MECHANISM: PROBLEM (mechanism confirmed from source, not the note alone). The ceremony loop is powered by two seams acting together:

1. scripts/hooks/claude_stop.py:main (~line 203) blocks the stop whenever `wake_armed(session_id)` is False. wake_armed reads the PER-SESSION seat file (_seat_path -> bifrost_wake_<agent>_<sid>.pid) and demands THIS session have its own live listener. It knows nothing about sibling sessions of the same agent id.

2. core/comm/bifrost_api.py:wake_block (~line 109-113) SEEDS its local detection cursor `_wake_since` from `self.bus.cursor()` (the SHARED agent-id cursor) whenever that cursor is non-virgin. bus.wait(since=..., since_out=...) then does an xread starting AT that position; if unread mail already sits past the shared cursor, xread returns it IMMEDIATELY (block only waits when nothing is past the id). For a REAL consumer this is correct (it should wake to drain its backlog). For a NON-HOLDER co-tenant that can never advance the shared cursor (consume_inbox degrades to peek — agent/bifrost_pull.py:consume_inbox / bifrost_api.inbox), the shared cursor stays permanently behind tail, so every re-armed watcher re-seeds at the stale shared cursor and insta-returns the same backlog -> fires -> exits 0 -> harness re-invokes -> stop hook demands a listener again -> goto arm. 20-40 cycles observed live (note t037-firsthand-wakeloop-data, id ADR_0712031218_ac8fde81).

The fix has two reinforcing parts. Part 1 is the loop-breaker; Part 2 is defense-in-depth for the residual fallback path.

PART 1 — Stop-hook wakeable-by-proxy (the loop-breaker). Insert a `_proxy_wakeable(session_id)` gate in claude_stop.py:main BETWEEN the `wake_armed` failure and the block (currently line 203). New control flow:
  if wake_armed(my_session):            # unchanged: I have my own listener
      pass
  elif _proxy_wakeable(my_session):     # NEW: a live sibling that consumes is already armed
      pass                              # wakeable-by-proxy -> stop cleanly, arm NOTHING
  else:
      <existing block: arm your own listener>   # unchanged safe fallback

_proxy_wakeable(my_session) (pure-ish, fail-CLOSED to the safe fallback on any error):
  a. holder = runner_lock.holder(AGENT)  (core/comm/runner_lock.py:holder). If None -> return False (no consumer seat exists; I may be the intended consumer -> arm).
  b. my_token = f"session:{my_session}" (matches the token the hook already refreshes at line 201 and runner_lock.session_holder_token()). If holder.get("token") == my_token -> return False (I hold the consumer seat -> I AM the consumer -> I must arm my own listener; never defer the consumer).
  c. holder_session = holder["token"].split("session:",1)[1]. Enumerate wake_seat.iter_seats(AGENT) (core/comm/wake_seat.py:iter_seats) and find a seat whose session_id == holder_session with a LIVE pid (reuse claude_stop._pid_alive on wake_seat.read_pid(path)). If found -> return True (the live seat-holder — a real Claude session with its own stop hook and listener — is armed; the agent id is wakeable AND the waker is the one that consumes). Else -> return False (holder has no live listener; fall back to arming so the agent id never goes dark).
This ends the loop because a genuine non-holder now arms NOTHING and stops. It is exactly the note's direction (a)/(c). It degrades to CURRENT behavior (arm my own listener) whenever the proxy target is not provably a live armed consumer — so it can never make the agent id LESS wakeable than today.

PART 2 — Non-holder tail-anchor in the watcher (kills the insta-fire on the fallback arm). When the proxy is unavailable and a session must still arm (e.g. no live seat-holder yet, or a transient re-arm race), stop it from busy-firing on the static backlog. In scripts/bifrost_wake.py:watch, compute at arm time `is_consumer = (runner_lock.holder(agent) or {}).get("token") == runner_lock.session_holder_token()`. Thread a `prefer_tail=not is_consumer` flag into a new keyword on bifrost_api.wake_block. In

PINS:
- tests/test_stop_proxy_wake.py::test_ceremony_loop_regression_proxy_accepts — HEADLINE PIN. Build the exact degenerate state: agent has a backlog (shared cursor behind tail), a FOREIGN live session holds the consumer-seat key AND has a live wake seat file (pid alive), and the payload session_id is a non-holder. Assert claude_stop.main() emits NO {'decision':'block'} for the wake check (proxy accepted). Reverting the fix -> hook blocks -> the loop. This is the pin that must be RED before impl.
- tests/test_stop_proxy_wake.py::test_proxy_false_when_i_hold_the_seat — holder.token == f'session:{my_session}' and I am not armed -> _proxy_wakeable returns False -> hook still blocks (the consumer must arm; never defer the consumer). Guards F4/the unwakeable-consumer regression.
- tests/test_stop_proxy_wake.py::test_proxy_false_when_holder_has_no_live_listener — holder is a foreign session but its wake-seat pid is DEAD (or no seat file) -> proxy False -> hook blocks (fall back to arming; never defer to a phantom). Guards F1/F3.
- tests/test_stop_proxy_wake.py::test_proxy_false_when_no_seat_holder — runner_lock.holder(AGENT) is None -> proxy False -> hook blocks (an unseated agent id must arm someone).
- tests/test_bifrost_wake.py::test_nonholder_tailanchor_holds_under_backlog — a watcher armed with prefer_tail=True while N unread already sit past a stale shared cursor must HOLD (wake_block returns [] to the block deadline) instead of insta-returning the backlog; a message arriving AFTER arm still fires it. The Part-2 pin.
- tests/test_bifrost_wake.py::test_consumer_still_seeds_at_shared_cursor — is_consumer=True keeps the current seed-at-shared-cursor behavior so a real consumer STILL wakes on its backlog (prevents Part 2 from starving the real consumer). Guards F4.
- kill-drill tests/test_stop_proxy_wake.py::test_loop_drill_terminates — drive the real cycle: seed a foreground fake holder (consumer-seat key + live seat file) + a backlog, then run claude_stop.main() as the non-holder repeatedly; assert it stops blocking within 1 cycle (loop dies). Inverse drill: kill the holder's listener mid-run and assert the non-holder RE-ARMS on its next stop (fail-safe, never silent).
DEPENDS_ON:
- T036 (single-writer consumer-seat election / seat identity) — STRONGEST interlock. T037's proxy correctness rests on 'the seat-holder token identifies a real, live, CONSUMING session distinct from a same-token sidecar.' Today RB-21 re-entrancy is token-only (runner_lock.acquire ~line 95-103 ignores pid), so a non-consuming MCP sidecar can refresh the seat under the conversational session's token (note t036-nonconsuming-seat-claimant, ADR_0712042614): holder.token==mine even though nobody consumes. T037 handles that case only by degrading (proxy False -> arm, anchored at tail so no busy-loop) — it cannot make mail get consumed; that is T036's job. If T036 adds pid+role to the seat record and exposes a single is_consumer(agent,session) predicate, T037 should CONSUME that predicate instead of re-deriving from holder+iter_seats, and failure mode F1 evaporates. T036 and T037 must share ONE 'who is the consumer' definition.
- T038 (distinct agent id / per-session inbox — the shared-cursor root cause) — DISSOLVES most of T037. If every session gets its own AKASHIC_AGENT_ID (or per-session lane/sub-inbox), there is no shared cursor, no non-holder class, and every session is its own consumer; the proxy path becomes dead code (guarded off by 'holder is None or holder==mine'). T037 is explicitly the mitigation for the world where agent id is STILL shared (its title: same-id concurrent sessions). No conflict: T037 buys correctness now; T038 makes it unnecessary later. Per-session addressability (reaching a specific twin) is OUT OF T037 scope and belongs to T038 — T037 accepts that a non-holder twin is reachable only via the holder.
- T039 (session-id inheritance / runner identity) — governs whether the token T037 reads is trustworthy. A DeepSeek runner that inherited CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID (the incident) can claim the seat under a session token; T037 then sees a 'holder' that is a runner, not a Claude session with a stop hook + wake seat -> iter_seats finds no matching live seat -> proxy False -> safe fallback arm. T039 giving runners a distinct token/role makes holder attribution truthful so T037 defers only to real sessions. T037 depends on T039 for the holder-token -> session-that-has-a-stop-hook mapping to be sound; until then T037 is merely conservative (never wrongly silent), not wrong.

header.title: ULTRACODE RUN: T036-T039 coordination-arc design (2026-07-12)

body:
# ULTRACODE v2: T036-T039 coordination arc -> FENCE-READY (2026-07-12)

Workflow wf_a860ac82-b21. 9/9 agents, 0 errors (length-bounded schema fixed the v1 retry-cap that dropped T036). 669k tokens, ~14.5 min. Round 2 = fold v1 AMEND fixes + design the dropped T036 keystone + adversarial re-verify under the shared-identity defining condition.

---

## SYNTHESIS (fence-ready)

UNIFIED DESIGN:
INTEGRATED T036-T039 COORDINATION ARC (round-2, folding all AMEND_AGAIN corrections).

DEFINING CONDITION held against throughout: three Claude twins share env token `session:envS` but carry distinct payload sessions; agent-keyed presence()/holder() show ONE 'claude'. Every fix keys on process pid or PASSED payload session, never on the shared token or agent-keyed presence.

T036 (identity keystone, front gate). Five edits to core/comm/runner_lock.py, all consuming the pid the record ALREADY writes (:90/:146), never a new identity store. (1) acquire():100 re-entrant branch refuses when a DISTINCT concurrently-live pid holds our token (`held==getpid() or not _live_distinct_pid(held)` passes; else refuse→peek). (2) is_consumer(agent, session_id) — the SINGLE predicate T037/T038/T039 consume — compares seat token to the PASSED session_id (never os.getenv) + a live wake_seat watcher; under fracture all twins get False, clean identity gives exactly one True. (3) scrub_session_env() at runner/daemon entrypoints closes runner-impersonation. (4) render_seats() surfaces holder session+pid+age at boot/fleet-doctor. (5) NEW — CLOSES THE REOPENED HOLE: apply the same _live_distinct_pid guard to heartbeat()'s own-token branch (:137/:146) and to refresh_consumer(). The stop hook (claude_stop.py:200) calls refresh_consumer→heartbeat UNCONDITIONALLY every turn; without (5) a non-consuming twin's heartbeat overwrites the seat with its own pid (recovering gen from the record at :145), migrating the cursor-consumer seat and re-firing edit-(1)'s refusal against the TRUE consumer — the RB-21 hole merely relocated from acquire() to heartbeat(). Fix: before the :146 overwrite, if rec.pid is a distinct-live pid, stand down (return False); P12 cross-process gen-recovery is preserved ONLY for same-process / dead-prior-turn reclaim. This also stabilizes render_seats (4), which reads holder().pid.

T039 (lanes, front gate, near-parallel with T036, no identity dependency — FENCE_READY). New core/comm/lanes.py: capped ROSTER{work,trace,sig,test}, KIND_LANE, DISPLAY_ONLY, WAKE_WATCHED={work}, SEATED={work}. Three OWNED _emit edits (bus.py:235-256): de-bell DISPLAY_ONLY (guard before _ring_bell, whose module-level BELL_NS otherwise rings bifrost:bell:* per trace line), root-gate _touch presence, suppress promote on DISPLAY_ONLY. Roster invariants (SEATED⊆WAKE_WATCHED; salient⇒SEATED lane) are PURE STRUCTURAL frozenset pins — zero presence()/holder() calls, twin-safe — asserted GREEN BEFORE strangler-fig cutover (AKASHIC_LANE_CUTOVER). FOLD (minor): widen the disjointness pin to DISPLAY_ONLY ∩ (salient ∪ control ∪ WORK-directed-wake e.g. nudge) == ∅. Nudge stays on WORK. Honest bound: de-fuels the dominant per-toolcall trace storm on BOTH wake paths, shrinking the contended surface to the single work seat — necessary-but-not-sufficient; co-consume close is T036/T037.

T037 (stop-hook proxy, hard-after T036, soft-after T039). CORRECTED to remove the over-correction: DROP Part-1 total-deferral (arm-nothing), which opened an unbounded wakeability hole — a deferred idle twin has no background task, so on holder-exit/TTL-expiry ALL siblings stay unarmed and bus-unreachable. Instead every non-consumer arms Part-2's TAIL-ANCHORED listener: is_cons=is_consumer(AGENT, payload_session); prefer_tail=not is_cons threads a new wake_block kwarg seeding from bus.tail() not cursor() — a non-consumer fires only on mail arriving AFTER arm (one-per-message, no insta-fire loop), while staying armed and reachable. FOLD: make wake_seat.is_watcher agent-aware (match the 'claude' consumer, not bare 'bifrost_wake' substring) to reject recycled wrong-agent watchers; keep the WMI process_snapshot off the frequent path (short timeout, fail-closed-to-arm). Consumer still seeds at shared cursor.

T038 (work-token FSM, DESIGN-ONLY + hand-pilot, hard-after T036/T037/T039/T040). Folds four corrections: (b) generation authority is genuinely SCOPE-keyed via the per-scope lease's own generation (bifrost:runner:<scope> nx SET carries its scope generation — the legitimate single authority for that scope, NOT the agent-keyed GEN_PREFIX at :89, NOT a parallel namespace); (c) expectations registry keyed by instance_id for ownership BUT _replies_since keeps reading the shared 'claude' inbox filtered by refs==offer_id (rebinding the READ stream to instance_id reads an empty inbox → dead-loop); (d) rebind intent proposal:{round}:{agent} to include instance_id so two twins don't last-writer-wins collapse to one proposal; (e) NEVER DELete the generation key (violates the monotone-fencing invariant; a low-gen re-mint lets a paused stale holder pass the write-fence) — rely on TTL-coherent leak-tolerant handling + verify_still_held() (f) at decision time as the reconciling backstop. Solo fast-path stays gated behind presence_is_process_distinct(); default-negotiate.

BUILD ORDER:
- Front gate A — T036 identity keystone: all FIVE runner_lock.py edits including the NEW heartbeat()/refresh_consumer() own-token pid guard (edit 5). is_consumer(agent,session), presence_is_process_distinct(), per-process instance_id on the seat record, scrub_session_env(), render_seats(). Land the pins incl. test_reentrancy_refuses_live_twin_pid AND a new test_heartbeat_refuses_live_twin_overwrite before proceeding.
- Front gate B — T039 lanes (near-parallel with T036, no identity dep): core/comm/lanes.py + three owned _emit edits + widened disjointness pin. Assert structural roster invariants GREEN, dual-write behind AKASHIC_LANE_CUTOVER, then retire legacy trace write.
- T037 stop-hook proxy — hard-after T036 (consumes is_consumer + token+pid re-entrancy), soft-after T039 (lanes shrink Part-2 residual). Ship the CORRECTED single-model: every non-consumer arms tail-anchored (no arm-nothing deferral); agent-aware is_watcher; hot-path WMI guarded.
- T040 packet envelope (prerequisite for T038 wire shape — flagged, out of this arc's authored scope but a hard dep).
- T038 work-token FSM — hard-after T036/T037/T039/T040. DESIGN-ONLY + single-writer hand-pilot first. Scope-keyed lease generation, instance_id-keyed expectations ownership with shared-inbox+refs read, instance_id-keyed intent proposals, no gen-key DEL, verify_still_held() backstop on every decision path.

STILL_OPEN: None
READY_TO_FENCE: True

ROUND-2 COORDINATION DATA:
CONVERGENCE: round-2 improved on round-1 but did NOT fully close. Round-1: ALL FOUR returned AMEND and the T036 keystone was DROPPED — the failure mode was directional (designs sound-looking but anti-safe at the incident's crux, keying on the shared token / agent-keyed presence that collapse under twins). Round-2: T039 reached FENCE_READY; T037 holes_closed=true (its new hole is a refinement, not a v1 reopen); T036 and T038 returned AMEND_AGAIN with holes_closed=false but BOTH diagnosed as few-edit-closable, explicitly NOT REJECT. So the trend is convergent: the surviving defects got smaller and more mechanical each round. NEW HOLES appeared, and their SHAPE is the key second data point: round-1 holes were 'wrong altitude' (anti-safe at the crux); round-2 holes are 'incomplete propagation of a correct fix' — T036 patched acquire() but not the symmetric heartbeat()/refresh_consumer() path the stop hook walks unconditionally (RB-21 relocated, not eliminated); T037 over-corrected (total-deferral bought per-message efficiency at the cost of a wakeability coverage gap on holder-exit); T038 mis-keyed the generation authority (agent-keyed GEN_PREFIX vs the scope-keyed claim) and mis-targeted the reply READ stream. This is the signature of adversarial refinement converging: each pass the fix is directionally right but the blast radius of the remaining error shrinks. METHOD VALIDATION: the decisive catch (T036 heartbeat side-door) was only visible because the verifier read SOURCE not the note — the note's own inline comment at claude_stop.py:200 FALSELY asserts 'heartbeat refuses foreign tokens → safe no-op', which is false under twins who share the token. A note-trusting review would have shipped the relocated hole. I independently re-verified both load-bearing claims against source (heartbeat token-only at runner_lock.py:137/146; GEN_PREFIX agent-keyed at :89) — both confirmed. Two rounds of fenced adversarial cross-check took the arc from 4/4-anti-safe to 1 FENCE_READY + 1 nearly-closed (T037) + 2 mechanically-closable, with every fix now holding under the shared-identity defining condition rather than a clean-identity world.

FENCE BRIEF (blind, for deepseek):
BLIND PROBLEM BRIEF (deepseek sees ONLY the problem; design your own fix independently).

INCIDENT (real, 2026-07-12, Akashic Aurora repo E:/AI-Setup). Three Claude agent instances were launched sharing AKASHIC_AGENT_ID='claude'. They therefore shared one bus inbox (bifrost:inbox:claude), one consumer seat, and one work cursor. Symptom: an indefinite 'ceremony loop' — one session fired its stop-hook wake listener repeatedly (40+/session) on shared-cursor traffic it could never consume, while the true consumer's mail was co-eaten by co-tenants (twin-eats-mail / mail-integrity hazard).

ROOT MECHANICS (verify against source before designing):
1. Consumer-seat re-entrancy in core/comm/runner_lock.py is TOKEN-ONLY: acquire() (~:100) returns True when rec['token']==token and IGNORES the pid written at ~:90. heartbeat() (~:137/:146) is likewise token-only and overwrites pid unconditionally. The token is a SESSION identity that legitimately spans many short-lived turn-processes, so a naive 'token AND pid==getpid()' would break a session's own next-turn reclaim.
2. THE DEFINING CONDITION: env token and payload session DIVERGE for twins. session_holder_token() (runner_lock.py:~177) reads the SHARED env CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID; the stop hook (scripts/hooks/claude_stop.py, session_id from payload ~:194) refreshes under session:payload. So env-session != payload-session, yet Bus.presence() (bus.py:~187) and holder() are AGENT-keyed and show ONE 'claude' under three twins. Any fix that keys on the token, on os.getenv, or on agent-keyed presence COLLAPSES.
3. The stop hook (claude_stop.py:~200) calls refresh_consumer→heartbeat UNCONDITIONALLY every turn — a non-consuming twin can thereby migrate the seat via the heartbeat path even if acquire() is guarded.
4. A per-toolcall TRACE firehose shares the single 'bifrost' stream family: it floods the wake xread read-set AND rings the dispatcher doorbell (bell_channel uses module-level BELL_NS, not the lane's ns), fueling the insta-fire storm.

REQUIREMENTS. Your fix must hold UNDER condition (2), not just a clean-identity world. Reuse existing seams — name them: runner_lock.py (lease/generation/holder/heartbeat), bus.py (advance_to/tail/namespace/BELL_NS/presence), wake_seat.py (iter_seats/process_snapshot/is_watcher/read_pid), claude_stop.py, agent/bifrost_pull.py, core/comm/expectations.py, core/coord/task_ledger.py, core/coord/intent.py. Do NOT introduce a new identity/presence store. Constraints: (a) a session must keep re-entrant reclaim across its OWN turns and after a dead prior-turn — only a concurrently-live DISTINCT process on one seat is illegitimate; (b) fixes must fail toward peek/arm-own-listener, never toward co-consume or toward silence; (c) hot paths (the stop hook) are latency-sensitive — avoid heavy per-message process introspection; (d) note that GEN_PREFIX is AGENT-keyed and permanent (monotone fencing token — never delete it); (e) any 'am-I-alone' decision cannot trust agent-keyed presence under twins. Deliver: how you make the consumer seat process-distinct under a shared token (acquire AND heartbeat), how a non-consuming twin's stop hook avoids the insta-fire loop while STAYING bus-reachable if the true holder exits, how you separate the trace firehose from work mail without silencing directed wakes/negotiation doorbells, and (design-only) how you'd fence concurrent work-claim negotiation under process-distinct identity. Pre-register your test pins (M3) and name new failure modes (M8). Ground every claim in the actual line-level behavior of the named seams.

---

## RE-VERIFY T039: FENCE_READY (holes_closed=True)
- NEW (minor, non-blocking, within declared NF2): the DISPLAY_ONLY disjointness pin (test_display_only_disjoint_from_salient_and_control) asserts DISPLAY_ONLY is disjoint from salient+control kinds but NOT from directed-wake kinds like nudge (which is neither salient nor a CONSOLE/control kind, per promoter.py:20/32 and bifrost_api.py:145). A future misconfig placing a directed-wake kind in DISPLAY_ONLY would silence its doorbell in _emit (bus.py:247 guard) -- the very nudge-silencing regression the correction just fixed. Recommend widening the structural pin to DISPLAY_ONLY disjoint from (salient union control union WORK-directed-wake kinds). Identity-independent; does not reopen any v1 hole.

## RE-VERIFY T036: AMEND_AGAIN (holes_closed=False)
- PRIMARY / keystone not actually closed: the seat pid is written in TWO places and edit (1) guards only acquire(). heartbeat() (runner_lock.py:137 token-only check, :146 unconditional pid=os.getpid() write) is left token-only. refresh_consumer()->heartbeat() is called UNCONDITIONALLY by every session's stop hook at claude_stop.py:200 (whose inline comment falsely assumes 'heartbeat refuses foreign tokens -> safe no-op' — false under twins, who share the token). Under the defining condition a NON-consuming twin's stop hook overwrites the seat with its own pid (recovering gen from the record at :145) and refreshes the TTL. Consequences: (a) the real consumer is then refused on its next acquire() because held=the twin's live-distinct pid — edit (1) fires against the wrong victim; (b) the seat migrates to whichever twin last fired its stop hook, with no release/crash.
